function.name: done
function.arguments: {"summary": "The red block is inside the blue bowl. The wrist camera hovering over the bowl shows the block resting on the bowl floor before and after I opened the jaws above it. A clean pinch grasp kept missing by a few centimeters, so I moved the block into the bowl with progressive jaw pushes: two ~4-8 cm plow pushes across the table carried it from near x=-0.11 into the bowl mouth, and the final open left it settled inside.", "hindsight": "On this rig the gripper open/close latch transitions are the only moves that run ~80 control steps; plain position moves run 1-3 steps and the damped servo covers only ~2 mm per step, so large transports must be built from latch-fuse calls. Pad bottoms reach the table when the TCP is below ~0.83, which wedges the jaws and stalls the open fuse - recover by re-commanding open with a higher z. The small red patches in the fixed cameras near the gripper are gripper markings, not the block; trust the wrist camera (rigid with the TCP) for block localization and expect it to hide the block when the block is within ~2 cm of the jaw axis."}
